subject: Order form: scope coverage, pricing exceptions & invoicing flow
messages:
From: Danielle Hart <danielle.hart@bluefox.io>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@bluefox.io
Date: Fri, 06 Jun 2025 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: BlueFox - Order Form redline + questions on invoicing/entities

Hi Karthik / Ben,

Attached is our redlined Order Form (BlueFox_OrderForm_Redline_20250606.docx). A few items to highlight so we can close quickly: 

- Net terms: procurement is requesting Net45 rather than Net30 due to internal AP cycles. Can Redwood accept Net45 for the first 12 months?
- Minimum commit phasing: the contract calls out a single annual commit — we'd like a 2-tranche approach (50%/50%). Need confirmation on how that affects pricing and activation fees.
- Tax/withholding: our tax team flags a possible 10% withholding in-country. We need guidance on whether Redwood will gross-up or if BlueFox should provide tax evidence.
- Invoicing entity: is Redwood able to invoice the US entity only, or do we need separate invoices per jurisdiction? Our preference is a single US-billed invoice for this agreement.

Can you loop legal and billing? We have a tentative procurement approval this Friday if terms align.

Attachments: BlueFox_OrderForm_Redline_20250606.docx (Word, 350KB)

Thanks,
Danielle Hart
Sr. Procurement Manager | BlueFox Analytics
procurement@bluefox.io

--

Subject: Re: BlueFox - Order Form redline + questions on invoicing/entities

Danielle — thanks for the redline and callout. Quick response from our side: 

- Net45: we can accept Net45 for year 1 conditional on a standard credit check and an agreed invoice cadence (monthly invoices against committed consumption).
- Tranche approach: 50/50 is feasible; we'll need to adjust the activation fee proration. I'll attach a short payment schedule proposal.
- Tax withholding: looping legal (Kimberly) to advise on gross-up vs evidence.
- Invoicing entity: our billing team prefers a single US invoice for simplicity; if BlueFox confirms US entity only, that's the path of least resistance.

Next steps: Kimberly — can you review the tax withholding language and the redline? Ben — can you confirm whether payments ops can support Net45 with monthly invoices and whether we need a PO upfront to trigger the first tranche?

I will set a 30-minute sync if we need to triage. Thanks all.

Attachments: payment_schedule_proposal_20250606.xlsx (Excel, 12KB)

Best,

On Fri, Jun 6, 2025 at 2:12 PM Danielle Hart <danielle.hart@bluefox.io> wrote:
> Appreciate the quick turnaround. We'll wait on legal's note.
From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Danielle Hart <danielle.hart@bluefox.io>
Date: Sat, 07 Jun 2025 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BlueFox - Order Form redline + questions on invoicing/entities

Hi Danielle / Karthik — legal has reviewed the attached redline and I have three primary notes: 

1) Tax withholding: our standard position is to not gross-up for withholding unless there is a legal obligation to do so. We can include an explicit mechanism: if BlueFox is required by local law to withhold, BlueFox must provide official tax receipts and Redwood will cooperate on crediting, but the customer remains responsible for withheld amounts unless we agree a gross-up in writing.

2) Billing entity and PO: Redwood can invoice a single Redwood US entity. However, we need BlueFox to confirm the exact legal entity name and remit-to details. If BlueFox later requests multiple entity invoicing, that will require an amendment to the Order Form.

3) Minimum commit / pricing exceptions: the 50/50 tranche is acceptable. We propose the following language edits to avoid ambiguity: add a schedule that maps tranche dates to prorated activation fees and the effective unit price for each tranche period. This protects both sides if usage skews.

I've attached our annotated comments in PDF (RWD_OrderForm_Comments_20250607.pdf). Suggested edits are inline and include fallback: if customer misses tranche 1 payment, Redwood may suspend capacity after a 10 business day cure period.

Please confirm BlueFox can provide: (a) entity legal name and tax ID; (b) confirmation on withholding policy; (c) whether procurement requires a single final invoice or monthly invoices against the commitment.

Attachments: RWD_OrderForm_Comments_20250607.pdf (PDF, 220KB)

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Li <marcus.li@bluefox.io>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Danielle Hart <danielle.hart@bluefox.io>, procurement@bluefox.io
Date: Sun, 08 Jun 2025 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BlueFox - Order Form redline + questions on invoicing/entities

Kimberly / Karthik — thanks for the notes. A few clarifications from BlueFox: 

- Billing entity: confirmed — "BlueFox Analytics, Inc." (US) will be the invoiced entity. Tax ID: 12-3456789.
- Withholding: our tax team says no domestic withholding for US invoices; the 10% flag was for a potential foreign affiliate invoice. For this agreement we can commit to US entity invoicing with no withholding.
- Invoicing cadence: procurement prefers monthly invoices against committed spend (helps with reconciliation). They will issue a PO that references the Order Form.
- Activation fee proration: tentative acceptance of proration deferred to the first invoice if Redwood confirms the mechanics.

Linking our DocuSign envelope here for the draft: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/EXAMPLE-12345

If those points work, we can sign on Monday.

Regards,
Marcus Li
Head of Finance Operations | BlueFox Analytics
procurement@bluefox.io

Subject: BlueFox order form — next steps and internal checklist

Team — quick internal summary and proposed next steps before I update the DocuSign draft: 

1) Commercials agreed in principle: Net45 (year 1) + monthly invoices against committed spend; 50/50 tranche on minimum commit with prorated activation fee.
2) Risk/cash ops: Ben — confirm with payments ops whether we require PO upfront to trigger tranche 1 or if we can accept a PO reference on the first invoice plus credit check. If payments ops requires PO to trigger, we'll ask BlueFox to route PO this week.
3) Legal: Kimberly — please prepare a short amendment (1-pager) that: (a) adds the tranche schedule; (b) contains the withholding mechanics language you proposed; (c) clarifies suspension rights after 10 business day cure. We should keep edits tight to avoid re-review.
4) Docs: I'll update the DocuSign envelope with the redlined OF + our amendment once we confirm PO requirements and receive the PO reference and tax ID from BlueFox.
5) Timing: Marcus indicated they can sign Monday if we provide the final DocuSign. Let's aim to have the amendment + payments ops sign-off by Thursday EOD.

Action items:
- Ben: payments ops check (PO requirement) — due EOD Wed 2025-06-11.
- Kimberly: draft amendment (short form) — due Thu 2025-06-12.
- Karthik: update DocuSign and send final to BlueFox once above are done.

I'll hold off sending DocuSign update until we have Ben/Kimberly confirmation. Then I'll include the envelope link and routing.

Thanks,
Karthik
